interpretation: The model explains 20% of variance in air quality from water pollution alone. This confirms that water and air quality are correlated indicators of overall environmental health — but a multivariate model incorporating plastic production volume and disposal methods would significantly improve predictive power.
next_steps: Add plastic production volume as a feature
Include disposal method distribution per country
Try Random Forest or Gradient Boosting for non-linear relationships
Use K-fold cross-validation for more reliable performance estimates
